bull.probability_evidence: Evaluation bull case cites ROIC rising five straight years (11.0%→20.8%), net debt/EBITDA falling (1.29x→0.79x) and a 4.04% YoY share-count reduction (research/TRV/2026-10-07-evaluation.md bull case, citing RA/BS/IS/ST), but conviction is only 3/5 and the bear case's P/B-above-5y-max concern caps this as the minority outcome.

target_band.cite: Half the spread between two valuation anchors for the bull re-rate: P/E re-rating to its 5y median 11.0x from 9.7x implies 360.64*(11.0/9.7)=408.98; EV/EBITDA re-rating to its 5y median 8.5x from 7.3x implies 360.64*(8.5/7.3)=419.93 (factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation table, RA). Half-spread (419.93-408.98)/2=5.48, /409 target = 0.0134; below the 0.2099 blended residual vol (mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended).

base.probability_evidence: Evaluation note: P/E (9.7x) is already in line with the peer median (9.7x) and EV/EBITDA is 5% below the peer median (factsheet Valuation table, RA), i.e. the market has already priced some ROE normalization without an earnings collapse — the modal, business-as-usual outcome absent a reserve/catastrophe surprise at Q3 results.

target_band.cite: Half the spread between two valuation anchors for the base case: P/E held flat at current 9.7x implies 360.64 (no re-rating); EV/EBITDA priced at its peer median 7.7x (vs current 7.3x) implies 360.64*(7.7/7.3)=380.40 (factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation table, RA, P:CB/ALL/PGR/HIG). Half-spread (380.40-361)/2=9.70, /361 target = 0.0269; below the 0.2099 blended residual vol (mc-inputs.json).

bear.probability_evidence: Evaluation bear case: P/B (2.3x) is above TRV's own 5-year max (2.0x) and 27% above the peer median (factsheet Valuation table, RA) [Certain]; probability was raised 0.05 above an even split on the macro overlay's small bear tilt from rising real yields pressuring book value through AOCI (research/TRV/2026-10-07-macro.md macro_tilt).

target_band.cite: Half the spread between two valuation anchors for the bear compression: P/B compressing to its 5y max 2.0x from 2.3x implies 360.64*(2.0/2.3)=313.6; EV/Sales compressing to its peer median 1.4x from 1.7x implies 360.64*(1.4/1.7)=296.99 (factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation table, RA, P:CB/ALL/PGR/HIG — both multiples sit above TRV's own 5y max and peer median, the two overvalued anchors the bear case cites). Half-spread (313.6-296.99)/2=8.31, /314 target = 0.0265; below the 0.2099 blended residual vol (mc-inputs.json).

expected_12m_move.cite: mc-inputs.json factor_news.SPY headlines are mixed over the same week (record highs led by narrow 'Magnificent Seven' tech leadership and a Goldman bullish call for a year-end record, vs 'rate chaos and narrow breadth' warnings, Market Watch 2026-10-06); the macro overlay (research/TRV/2026-10-07-macro.md) addresses rates, not the broad equity factor, so no net directional view on SPY is supported — set to 0 per house rule.

mc-inputs.json factor_news.IEF headlines alternate within the same week between a 'bond rout deepening' (WSJ 2026-10-01) and a Treasury 'rebound' pulling yields off multi-decade highs (Bloomberg 2026-10-02), described as 'whiplash' by ETF Trends (2026-10-02); the macro overlay (research/TRV/2026-10-07-macro.md) likewise presents both a bull path (yields stay elevated, no growth scare) and a bear path (yields keep rising OR reverse sharply) without forecasting net direction — mixed, set to 0 per house rule.

jumps.name: Q3 2026 earnings — adverse reserve development or elevated catastrophe losses
jumps.reason: Reserve releases have flattered recent ROE and need not repeat (research/TRV/2026-10-07.md §2, SEC 10-Q cite); the evaluation's bear case and trigger #3 both flag that Q3 2026 or later results showing adverse net prior-year reserve development would reverse the releases that flatter current ROE, with results due nine days after this valuation.
jumps.cite: research/TRV/2026-10-07-evaluation.md bear case ('Q3 results on Oct 16, 2026 ... add catastrophe and reserve risk in the near term') and trigger #3; factsheet-2026-10-07.md Price section, next earnings date Oct 16, 2026 [ST,OV]

annual_probability.cite: Of TRV's ~20 quarterly earnings events in the 5-year history (mc-inputs.json analogues.event_weeks, 2021-10-18 to 2026-09-28), only 1 (Q1 2022, week 2022-04-18, -6.04%) produced a move at or beyond this magnitude, implying roughly a 1-in-5-year (~0.20) annual probability of a comparable adverse reserve/catastrophe miss at earnings.

impact.cite: Largest adverse earnings-week move in TRV's history: Q1 2022 earnings release, week of 2022-04-18, -6.04% (mc-inputs.json analogues.event_weeks / all_weekly_moves)
